source_note: Checked live against the OpenRouter models endpoint on 2026-10-21. USD per million tokens, input/output. OpenRouter has no prompt caching, so cache_write mirrors input and cache_read is 0; the adapter records the cost OpenRouter itself reports per call and uses this table only as the pre-call reservation bound. All panel models have a context window of at least 262k tokens, so they read the full ~137k-token audit bundle uncut. gpt-6.1-sol is the frontier OpenAI seat; gpt-6-luna is the efficient one (no gpt-6.1-luna exists, so the newest Luna is used).
